title: Remittances & NRI Banking: A Roadmap
description: Learn how NRIs manage money transfers, NRE/NRO accounts, and RBI regulations.

nodes.label: What is Remittance?
nodes.description: Sending money across countries, often by NRIs to families in India.

nodes.label: NRE & NRO Accounts
nodes.description: NRE for freely repatriable foreign income, NRO for local Indian income with limited repatriation.

nodes.label: Banks & Exchange Houses
nodes.description: Use SWIFT, forex services, or apps like Wise/Remitly. Compare fees and exchange rates.

nodes.label: Forex Cards & Online Transfers
nodes.description: Convenient for students/travelers, load foreign currency, and use abroad.

nodes.label: FEMA & RBI Rules
nodes.description: RBI regulates remittances; FEMA governs foreign exchange in India.

nodes.label: Tax Implications
nodes.description: Tax depends on residency status, source of income, and DTAA agreements.

nodes.label: Test Yourself: Remittances
nodes.description: Quick test on accounts, methods, and rules.
